Resonance Skill 7→10, Normal Attack 6→10 when mats allow

keyFindings: Sub-DPS with real personal damage > dedicated buff bots. Zhezhi went 0-2 against replacements.
Tightest spread: Phoebe/Nyx/Chisa — 2 seconds. Most reliable: Augusta/Iuno/Shorekeeper — 3 seconds.
Resistance tax: Havoc team (uphill) 2:21.7 avg. Cartethyia (also uphill) 0:43.0 avg — raw power overcomes.
Aemeath support diff: with Changli/Lupa 1:16.0 avg vs with Lynae/Mornye 0:37.3 avg — 39 seconds faster.
3/29 Echo farming session: 7 resonators improved. Augusta CR fixed (red → green). Cantarella/Phoebe redistributed. Aemeath CD +17.4%. Zero red priorities remain.
5/23 Denia vs Lynae: Lynae S2 Amplification buffs (multiplicative) beat Denia's Fusion DMG Bonus (additive into saturated pool) for single-target. Heavenfall Edict: 1.04M (Lynae) vs 615k (Denia).

5/23 Multiplier bucket theory: Denia stacks same bucket as Aemeath S3's Fusion DMG. Lynae S2 multiplies across buckets (All-DMG Amplification). Different math architecture = different per-hit ceilings.
5/23 Content-specific queens: Fusion Burst team scored 4340 vs Legacy 2980 in Whimpering Wastes with Fusion Burst stage buff. Lynae bosses, Denia endgame scoring. Both earn their slot.
5/23 Rotation optimization: Aemeath combo path (Intro→Echo→Ult1→Mech B4→Seraphic→Aemeath B4→Seraphic→Charged II→Finale) + buff window alignment improved Denia team from 1:14 to 0:33.
5/23 Triple Pink Danger (Lupa→Denia→Aemeath): 0:53 no-healer speedrun. Optimal slot order based on outro buff type analysis (Lupa Deepen=multiplicative, Denia Bonus=additive, Aemeath=finisher).
5/23 Whimpering Wastes SS 7220 new record. Denia team scored 4340 on second half after S2 upgrade + rotation fix. 72% improvement from first attempt.
